clue.text: Ideas previously adopted by Communist Party, way back

indicators.note: something adopted is taken in, so the first word is held inside the party's initials
back tells us to read the word for way from its end to its start

blocks.note: standard abbreviation of Communist Party
once means at an earlier time
ST is short for street, a way

explanation.surface: Political ideas that the Communist Party took up long ago.
explanation.walkthrough: 'Way back' reads as long ago, but it is a road abbreviation turned round; ST for street is a standard crossword way.
explanation.definitionFit: Concepts are notions or abstract thoughts, a straightforward synonym for ideas.

clue.text: Female dons clearly on the wrong track

indicators.note: to don is to put on clothing, so the other word wraps itself around the letter for female

blocks.note: of course means obviously, clearly
standard abbreviation for female

explanation.surface: Women academics who have plainly lost their way.
explanation.walkthrough: 'Female dons' reads like women lecturers, but dons is the verb: OF COURSE puts on F, giving OF(F) COURSE.
explanation.definitionFit: Being off course means having strayed from the intended route, which is to be heading the wrong way.

clue.text: Veg is overcooked, we gather

indicators.note: we gather suggests something heard from others, so the word is taken by its sound

blocks.note: food that is overcooked is charred, burnt black

explanation.surface: Someone hears that the vegetables have been cooked too long.
explanation.definitionFit: Chard is a leafy green vegetable related to beet, and veg is the informal word for vegetables.

clue.text: Harbinger of bad CPU errors

indicators.note: bad letters are faulty ones, so they must be put into a different order

blocks.note: the letters as written

explanation.surface: Processor errors are a warning sign that something worse is coming for your computer.
explanation.definitionFit: A harbinger is a forerunner that signals something to come, as is a precursor.

clue.text: Kicked boozer in Slough

indicators.note: in places one word inside the other

blocks.note: to slough is to cast off or shed, as a snake does its skin
a boozer is British slang for a pub

explanation.surface: Someone got kicked in a pub in the town of Slough.
explanation.walkthrough: Slough looks like the Berkshire town, but it is the verb meaning shed: SH(INN)ED.
explanation.definitionFit: To shin someone is to kick them in the shins, so shinned can mean kicked.

clue.text: Wings of scarce hawk exhibited

indicators.note: the wings of a word are its two outermost letters, one at each side

blocks.note: first and last letters of scarce
to hawk goods is to sell them aggressively, to tout

explanation.surface: A rare bird of prey is put on show, its wings displayed.
explanation.walkthrough: Hawk looks like the bird, but here it is the verb to sell.
explanation.definitionFit: To set out goods is to arrange them on display, so set out means exhibited.

clue.text: Brooded over younger man, highly sexed

indicators.note: in a down entry over means the first part sits above the next

blocks.note: a hen sits on eggs when brooding
YR is an abbreviation for younger

explanation.surface: Someone dwelt on a younger, lusty man.
explanation.definitionFit: A satyr is a lecherous man, after the lustful goat-legged woodland creatures of Greek myth.

clue.text: Sailor died after Croat wrecked part of deck

indicators.note: after places the letter for died at the end, following the rest
something wrecked is broken up, so the letters are rebuilt in a new order

blocks.note: a tar is an old word for a sailor
the letters as written
D is the standard abbreviation for died

explanation.surface: A sailor died when a Croatian wrecked part of the ship's deck.
explanation.walkthrough: Deck suggests a ship, with sailors and wrecks, but it is a pack of cards.
explanation.definitionFit: A tarot card is one of the cards in a tarot pack, so it is one component of a deck.

clue.text: Drink, cycling in France, and topple over

indicators.note: cycling means the first letter moves round to the end of the word

blocks.note: to sup is to drink
et is French for and

explanation.surface: Someone drinks while bike riding in France and falls off.
explanation.walkthrough: SUP with its S moved to the back becomes UPS; add ET.
explanation.definitionFit: To upset something is to knock it over, overturning it.

clue.text: Old apartment close to collapse recently

indicators.note: the close of a word is its end, so only its final letter is used

blocks.note: O is the standard abbreviation for old
a flat is the British word for an apartment
last letter of collapse

explanation.surface: An old block of flats has lately been close to falling down.
explanation.definitionFit: Of late is an idiom for lately, in the recent past.

clue.text: Benefit of winter vest initially ignored

indicators.note: ignoring what comes initially means dropping the first letter of each word

blocks.note: as written
as written

explanation.surface: Questioning whether there is any point in wearing a winter vest.
explanation.definitionFit: Something done in your interest is for your advantage or good, so interest can mean benefit.

clue.text: Browned our nuts in stove

indicators.note: nuts means crazy, so the letters go wild and rearrange

blocks.note: the letters as written

explanation.surface: We toasted our nuts on the stove.
explanation.walkthrough: Nuts reads as the food being browned, but it is the signal to rearrange.
explanation.definitionFit: A wood burner is a stove that heats a room by burning logs.

clue.text: Oddly trustful Nobel Peace Prize winner

indicators.note: oddly keeps only the letters in odd positions: first, third, fifth and so on

blocks.note: first, third, fifth and seventh letters of trustful

explanation.surface: A peace laureate who was strangely trusting.
explanation.definitionFit: Archbishop Desmond Tutu of South Africa won the 1984 Nobel prize for opposing apartheid.

clue.text: French and British arbitrators quarrel

blocks.note: FR is the standard abbreviation for French
ACAS is the UK's Advisory, Conciliation and Arbitration Service, which settles labour disputes

explanation.surface: French and British mediators fall out with each other.
explanation.definitionFit: A fracas is a noisy disturbance or brawl, a rowdy dispute.

clue.text: Energy-dense cola ruined inside of mouth

indicators.note: ruined letters are wrecked and must be reassembled differently
the inside of a word is what remains once both end letters are removed

blocks.note: the letters as written
a mouth is an orifice; its inner letters are kept

explanation.surface: Sugary cola is high in calories and rots the inside of your mouth.
explanation.walkthrough: Mouth must first become ORIFICE before its insides are taken.
explanation.definitionFit: Calorific foods contain many calories, so they are rich in energy.

clue.text: Aversion is stated vigorously

indicators.note: doing something vigorously shakes it about, scrambling the letters

blocks.note: the letters as written

explanation.surface: Someone's dislike is expressed forcefully.
explanation.definitionFit: Distaste is a feeling of dislike or repugnance, close in sense to aversion.

clue.text: Feeling extremely submissive and small amid people

indicators.note: extremely points to the extremes of a word, its first and last letters
amid puts one thing in the middle of another

blocks.note: first and last letters of submissive
a nation is a people
S is the abbreviation for small

explanation.surface: Feeling very meek and tiny in a crowd.
explanation.walkthrough: The small letter sits amid the people, not amid the whole answer; the first two letters stay outside.
explanation.definitionFit: A sensation is a physical perception or feeling, such as warmth or touch.

clue.text: Reprimand Liberal becoming keen on borders

indicators.note: a phrase that borders something sits around its edges, enclosing it

blocks.note: taking to someone means growing keen on them
L is the standard abbreviation for Liberal

explanation.surface: A Liberal is told off for growing fond of border controls.
explanation.walkthrough: TA(L)KING TO: the phrase for keen on surrounds L.
explanation.definitionFit: A talking-to is a scolding or lecture given to someone who has misbehaved.

clue.text: Naval officers reportedly make out by cricket ground

indicators.note: reportedly means as heard, so the phrase is taken by its sound
by means next to, so one piece is placed beside the other

blocks.note: to make out something is to see it
Lord's is the famous London cricket ground

explanation.surface: Officers of the navy said to be kissing next to a cricket pitch.
explanation.walkthrough: Make out tempts as a kiss, but it means see; only that part is heard.
explanation.definitionFit: The Sea Lords are the senior admirals who sit on the Admiralty Board of Britain's Royal Navy.

clue.text: Furtiveness of the last suspect

indicators.note: suspect means dodgy or unreliable, so the letters are not in their proper order

blocks.note: the letters as written

explanation.surface: The final suspect behaves sneakily.
explanation.definitionFit: Stealth is secret, cautious action meant to avoid notice, which is furtiveness.

clue.text: Brain of Newton with strange conclusions from fateful apple

indicators.note: conclusions are endings, so only the final letter of each word is taken

blocks.note: N is the symbol for the newton, the unit of force
odd means strange
last letters of fateful and apple

explanation.surface: Isaac Newton's mind reached odd conclusions after the famous apple fell.
explanation.walkthrough: Newton tempts as Sir Isaac, but he is just the unit symbol.
explanation.definitionFit: Noddle is an old informal word for the head or brain.

clue.text: Leave mark on naked statuettes

indicators.note: naked means stripped of covering, so the outer letters are removed

blocks.note: the Oscars are the statuettes given as Academy Awards

explanation.surface: Damaging nude figurines.
explanation.walkthrough: Oscars are famously golden naked men; strip off the outside letters.
explanation.definitionFit: To scar is to leave a lasting mark on skin or a surface after an injury.

clue.text: Disorder of men with love for power

indicators.note: with one thing for another means swapping a letter out in favour of the new one

blocks.note: chaps is informal for men
love is zero in tennis, which looks like O
P is the symbol for power

explanation.surface: Men who swap their love of power for chaos.
explanation.walkthrough: Swap the P in CHAPS for O.
explanation.definitionFit: Chaos is complete confusion and lack of order.

clue.text: Mediterranean city and state controlled by Amazon’s assistant

indicators.note: something controlled is held in, so it sits inside the other piece

blocks.note: Alexa is Amazon's voice assistant
as written
RI is Rhode Island, a US state

explanation.surface: A port city and state run by Amazon's helper.
explanation.walkthrough: Amazon tempts as the river or the warrior women, but it is the tech company; RI is the postal code for Rhode Island.
explanation.definitionFit: Alexandria is Egypt's great port on the Mediterranean coast, founded by Alexander the Great.

clue.text: Sound of car beginning to overheat

indicators.note: the beginning of a word is its first letter

blocks.note: Audi is a German car make
first letter of overheat

explanation.surface: The noise a car makes when it starts to overheat.
explanation.definitionFit: Audio means sound, especially recorded or transmitted sound.

clue.text: The Pentagon for example lies about subterfuge

indicators.note: lying about means turned round, so the abbreviation runs backwards

blocks.note: the Pentagon houses the US Department of Defense, the DoD
e.g. abbreviates for example

explanation.surface: The US military lies to cover up a trick.
explanation.definitionFit: A dodge is a cunning trick to evade something, which is a subterfuge.

clue.text: Revolutionary cover of Vogue is yellow

indicators.note: a revolution turns something right round, so the whole run is read backwards

blocks.note: a lid is a cover
as written
a vogue is a fashion or fad

explanation.surface: A radical magazine cover is printed in yellow.
explanation.walkthrough: Vogue looks like the magazine, with its cover, but it means a fad.
explanation.definitionFit: Daffodil is the name of a pale yellow colour, after the spring flower.

clue.text: Colour of diamonds nicked by Jones the Architect

indicators.note: something nicked by someone is taken and held, so it goes inside

blocks.note: Inigo Jones was the 17th-century English architect
D is the abbreviation for the card suit diamonds

explanation.surface: A famous architect steals some coloured diamonds.
explanation.definitionFit: Indigo is a deep blue-violet colour, one of the colours of the rainbow.

clue.text: Film some tipsy choristers

indicators.note: some means a part of what follows, so the letters lie within those words

blocks.note: inside tiPSY CHOristers

explanation.surface: A movie about drunk members of a choir.
explanation.definitionFit: Psycho is Alfred Hitchcock's 1960 horror movie.

clue.text: Hot fury towards sycophant

blocks.note: H is the abbreviation for hot, as on taps
fury is great anger
on can mean towards, as in marching on a city

explanation.surface: Burning rage aimed at a toady.
explanation.definitionFit: A hanger-on is a follower who seeks favour by fawning, much like a sycophant.
